nodes.label: Regression tests for SFT streaming runtime cleanup when setup() fails (#1464).
Mock layer-streaming runtime with call tracking.
Mock model exposing trainable-parameter counts for SFT setup.
Build a minimal valid SFT configuration for testing.
Patch _setup_streaming_transformers to attach mock runtime and model.
Test 1: SFT setup failure during train mapping closes the streaming runtime.
Test 2: SFT setup failure during validation mapping closes the streaming…
Test 3: KeyboardInterrupt propagates and runtime closes exactly once.
Test 4: Inner cleanup during model loading does not result in a second close.
Test 5: Non-streaming setup failure propagates without runtime cleanup errors.
Test 6: Cleanup failure preserves original setup exception and logs warning.
Test 7: Successful setup keeps the streaming runtime open for training.
The close error is printed as typed and still never replaces the setup error.
